summary_en: For Startups initiated a share buyback program of up to 220,000 shares or JPY 300 million over November 6 to December 30, 2026, representing 3.4% of outstanding shares, citing undervaluation and capital efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief:
For Startups, Inc. resolved on November 5, 2026, to acquire up to 220,000 shares, or JPY 300 million maximum, during the period from November 6, 2026, through December 30, 2026. The shares will be acquired in the market on the Tokyo Stock Exchange at prevailing prices. The buyback represents 3.4% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of October 31, 2026 (6,452,718 shares outstanding).

The company cited two principal reasons for the buyback. First, the current share price level does not reflect the company's business growth prospects and stands at a substantially undervalued level. Second, management seeks to improve capital efficiency and expand shareholder returns through the acquisition. The buyback is authorized under the Company Law and was decided at a board meeting held on the announcement date.
